Audit.PageIntroduction: Read-only introspection of your Matomo instance. The report below is computed in real-time and can be exported as Markdown, ready to paste into a consulting deliverable.
Audit.NoFindings: No findings match the current filters.
Audit.RunError: An error occurred while running the audit. See server logs.
Audit.PremiumIntro: %1$s additional checks (privacy, users, web sites, data quality, Tag Manager, plugins, public file exposure, high traffic and multi-server) are listed below but only run in AuditPremium.
Audit.PremiumCheckText: This check is not run by the free Audit plugin. AuditPremium runs it on your instance and gives you the result and its recommendation.
Audit.SrvMatomoVersionTemplate: Your Matomo installation is currently running version {current} and can be safely upgraded to {expected}. The upgrade ships security fixes, performance improvements and new features. See the changelog for details.
Audit.SrvPhpVersionTemplate: Your current PHP version is {current}. Matomo 6 requires **PHP 8.1+**, but PHP 8.1 no longer receives security fixes: move to **PHP 8.2 or later**, ideally the **latest stable PHP 8.x release**, to benefit from performance improvements and security fixes.
Audit.SrvPhpFpmTemplate: Matomo recommends running under **PHP-FPM** (currently: `{current}`) for better resource isolation and worker control. PHP-FPM also offers dynamic process sizing, better suited to load spikes than a classic Apache module.
Audit.SrvPhpMemoryLimitTemplate: Your PHP `memory_limit` is set to `{current}`. To process long-range reports without fatal errors, set it to **2 GB minimum**, or 4 to 8 GB on high-volume instances.
Audit.SrvPhpMaxExecutionTimeTemplate: Your `max_execution_time` is set to `{current}`. Even though Matomo accepts lower values, we recommend raising it to **3600** (or **0** for unlimited) to avoid interrupting heavy operations like imports, invalidations or manual archiving.
Audit.SrvPhpPostMaxSizeTemplate: Your `post_max_size` is `{current}`, which may constrain large imports (big tagging plans, logo uploads, GA imports). We recommend raising it to **32M minimum**.
Audit.SrvPhpOpcacheTemplate: Enabling **OPcache** is explicitly recommended by Matomo to drastically reduce UI load time and CPU usage. System Check does not expose this information; it must be verified server-side.
Audit.SrvPhpExtensionsTemplate: The following PHP extensions must be loaded: `pdo`, `pdo_mysql`, `gd`, `curl`, `mbstring`, `xml`, `zlib`, `json`, `openssl`. Missing: `{current}`.
Audit.SrvPhpShellExecTemplate: Matomo requires `shell_exec` and `proc_open` for CLI processing (archiving, scheduled tasks). Check your `disable_functions` entry in `php.ini`.
Audit.SrvWebEngineTemplate: Your web server is `{current}`. Matomo recommends **NGINX** for peak performance, but Apache is fully supported. This change is not urgent if the instance meets current needs.
Audit.SrvMysqlVersionTemplate: Your database is `{current}`. Matomo 6 requires **MySQL 8.0+** or **MariaDB 10.6+**.
Audit.SrvMysqlEngineInnodbTemplate: Some tables may default to the **MyISAM** engine. Convert every Matomo table to **InnoDB** for better transaction, concurrency and crash-recovery handling.
Audit.SrvMysqlCharsetTemplate: Some Matomo tables are not using the `utf8mb4` collation. Convert them with `ALTER TABLE … CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci` to properly support emojis and multi-byte characters.
Audit.SrvMysqlMaxAllowedPacketTemplate: The `max_allowed_packet` setting must be large enough to carry big Matomo payloads. Recommended minimum: **512M**.
Audit.SrvMysqlWaitTimeoutTemplate: To avoid disconnects during long archiving operations, raise `wait_timeout` to **35000 seconds**.
Audit.SrvMysqlInnodbFlushLogTemplate: Setting `innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit = 2` can significantly boost tracker throughput (**up to 2x** on some installations), at the cost of losing at most one second of data on crash.
Audit.SrvMysqlInnodbBufferPoolTitle: innodb_buffer_pool_size ~ 60-80% of the DB host RAM
Audit.SrvMysqlInnodbBufferPoolTemplate: `innodb_buffer_pool_size` must be sized at **60–80% of the RAM** dedicated to the database host. It is the single MySQL setting with the largest impact on Matomo performance.
Audit.SrvMysqlIndexesTransitionsTemplate: The Matomo Transitions report slows down massively without dedicated indexes. Verify their presence and, if needed, create them with the SQL below.
Audit.SrvMysqlSlowQueryLogTemplate: The MySQL `slow_query_log` is disabled. Enable it to identify expensive queries during archiving and traffic peaks.
Audit.SrvMysqlUserPermissionsTitle: Full MySQL privileges for the Matomo user
Audit.SrvMysqlUserPermissionsTemplate: Matomo's MySQL user must hold these privileges: `SELECT`, `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, `CREATE`, `INDEX`, `DROP`, `ALTER`, `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLES`, `LOCK TABLES`. Missing: `{current}`.
Audit.SrvCronArchiverTemplate: The `core:archive` CRON has not run recently. Without it, reports stop being updated. Check the crontab and run `./console core:archive` manually to confirm it completes.
Audit.SrvGeoipDbTitle: GeoIP database configured (DBIP or MaxMind GeoLite2)
Audit.SrvGeoipDbTemplate: Current location provider is `{current}`. Matomo recommends **GeoIP2** (DBIP or MaxMind GeoLite2) for accurate country and region detection.
Audit.SrvSmtpConfiguredTitle: SMTP configured for reports and alerts
Audit.SrvSmtpConfiguredTemplate: Current mail transport is `{current}`. To guarantee delivery of report emails and alerts, configure an **explicit SMTP server** in the `[mail]` section of `config.ini.php`.
Audit.SrvFilePermissionsTitle: Write permissions on tmp/ and js/
Audit.SrvFilePermissionsTemplate: The `tmp/` and/or `js/` directories are not writable by the PHP process: `{current}`. Fix permissions to allow archiving and JS tracker auto-update.
Audit.SrvFileIntegrityTemplate: Matomo's file integrity check reports unexpected files in your installation. Review the full list in Admin → Diagnostics → System Check.
Audit.SrvEndpointsExposureTitle: Private directories not reachable from the internet
Audit.SrvEndpointsExposureTemplate: Some sensitive directories are not protected by a `.htaccess` file: `{current}`. On NGINX, add equivalent `deny` rules to your vhost.
Audit.CfgForceSslTemplate: SSL is not enforced on your Matomo instance. Add `force_ssl = 1` to the `[General]` section of `config.ini.php`.
Audit.CfgTrustedHostsTemplate: `trusted_hosts[]` is empty: Matomo is exposed to **Host header poisoning**. Explicitly declare the allowed domains in the `[General]` section of `config.ini.php`.
Audit.CfgCorsDomainsTemplate: Your CORS configuration allows every origin via a `*` wildcard. This exposes your Matomo API to any external origin. Leave the setting empty (default) or explicitly list the allowed domains.
Audit.CfgLoginBruteforceTemplate: `enable_login_brute_force_protection` is explicitly disabled in `config.ini.php`. Remove the override or reset it to `1` to restore the built-in Matomo protection.
Audit.CfgPasswordComplexityTemplate: `minimum_password_length` is too low (`{current}`). We recommend **12 characters minimum** for Matomo accounts.
Audit.CfgEnableAutoUpdateTemplate: On a **single-server** install, `enable_auto_update` should stay at `1` (recommended). In a **multi-server** environment it must be forced to `0` to avoid partial upgrades across the farm.
Audit.CfgMultiServerEnvironmentTemplate: The `multi_server_environment` flag must reflect the real topology: `1` if Matomo runs on several nodes, `0` otherwise. Current: `{current}`.
Audit.CfgUniqueVisitorsRangeTemplate: On a large database, aggregating unique visitors on custom ranges may double archiving time. Current: `{current}`. Set to `0` if you observe unusually long archive runs.
Audit.CfgUniqueVisitorsYearTemplate: On a large database, yearly unique-visitor aggregation can significantly slow archiving. Current: `{current}`. Set to `0` if you observe unusually long archive runs.
Audit.CfgCustomReportsMaxDimensionsTemplate: `custom_reports_max_dimensions` is set to `{current}`. We recommend at least **9 dimensions** to cover most custom-report use cases.
Audit.CfgMariadbSchemaTemplate: Your database is detected as **MariaDB** but `[database] schema` is `{current}`. Set it to `Mariadb` in `config.ini.php` so Matomo applies the right schema.
Audit.PlgInvalidTitle: No plugin in an invalid state
Audit.GenBrandingLogoTemplate: No custom logo is uploaded. Go to **Administration → General settings → Branding** to personalise the instance.
Audit.GenTrackingSpamOptionsTemplate: The three **TrackingSpamPrevention** filters must all be enabled: *cloud bots*, *headless browsers* and *server-side HTTP libraries*. Currently: `{current}`.
Audit.PrvLiveDisabledTitle: Live reports disabled under consent-exempt mode
Audit.PrvHeatmapsDisabledDefaultTitle: Heatmaps and Session Recording off by default
Audit.GenTimezoneConsistencyTitle: Consistent timezone between PHP, MySQL and Matomo
Audit.GenTimezoneConsistencyTemplate: The **PHP** and **MySQL** timezones do not match (`{current}`). Align them to avoid time-offset artefacts in archived reports.
Audit.SrvTrackerStatusTemplate: `record_statistics = {current}`: Matomo silently drops every incoming hit. Set it back to `1` in `[Tracker]` (or remove the override) to restore tracking.
Audit.SrvTrackerCacheShortTitle: Tracker cache TTL within recommended range
Audit.SrvTrackerCacheShortTemplate: `tracker_cache_file_ttl = {current}`. Keep the TTL between 60 s and 900 s so site-level changes (new goals, excluded IPs, currency) reach the tracker quickly without hammering the DB.
Audit.OpsLogsEnabledTitle: Application logs written to a persistent file
Audit.OpsLogsEnabledTemplate:
Matomo is not persisting its logs to a file. The stock `log_writers[] = screen` only prints to the PHP output buffer, so any error vanishes after the request ends. Configure a **file writer with an explicit path** so operations can tail and rotate the file:

```ini
[log]
log_writers[] = file
log_level = WARN
logger_file_path = /var/log/matomo/matomo.log
```

Make sure the target directory exists and is writable by the PHP worker (e.g. `www-data`).
